Business Summary

Shaan Painting DS Group provides professional interior and exterior painting services for residential and commercial properties throughout Melbourne, Geelong, Ballarat, Gippsland, and Regional Victoria. The company specialises in high-quality finishes, weatherboard restoration, new home painting, and complete property repaints using premium materials and proven preparation methods.
